mission.title: Фінальна реконструкція
mission.mission_role: final synthesis / delayed retrieval / source-cited reconstruction
learning_objectives: Reconstruct LN-01–LN-10 with citations and provenance.
Use LN-11 evidence relations without treating them as a ready-made answer.
Close prediction→fulfilment chains including Peter denial.
Detect false harmonization and articulate uncertainty.
mission.future_repetition_hooks: All node hooks are materialized as RESOLVED_NODE / REVIEW_QUEUE / DEFERRED_CAMPAIGN / RETIRED in node records.
mission.source_classification_notes: All answer-bearing narrative claims are inherited from prior audited LN material or direct T2 comparisons; new work is synthesis/provenance/uncertainty. TX1 never replaces confidence_code.
disputed_points: Exact merged minute-by-minute chronology remains D1.
Unnamed figures are not assigned identities without text.
Legal/procedural reconstruction beyond explicit Gospel wording is not T1.
mission.opening_brief: Reconstruct the campaign as a source-defensible evidence product rather than a single undocumented transcript.
mission.case_question: What final reconstruction can be defended when every material claim carries witness, passage, confidence and qualification?
known_facts_at_start: TX1 and uncertainty mechanics are already known.
mission.completion_synthesis: The final reconstruction distinguishes direct claims, comparisons, textual variants and unresolved precision; it ends at the Pilate handoff.
mission.failure_recovery_routes: Every partial/incorrect branch is explicit per node and returns to a valid remediation/current node or advances after guided resolution; no dead ends.
mission.completion_conditions: Complete 14 required nodes through independent or guided routes; preserve source/provenance/confidence/TX1 boundaries; all remediation routes must remain reachable.
mission.perfect_investigation_conditions: Independent completion of high-value recall/application/synthesis nodes plus optional evidence where offered; knowledge-performance only, never spiritual status.

accessibility.screen_reader_announcement_requirements: Announce node identity, source scope, result, evidence/confidence/TX1 qualification, mastery consequence, and next action.
accessibility.nonvisual_equivalent: Canonical final record is structured text; every board/timeline has a linear editable equivalent and screen-reader feedback includes result/evidence/confidence/qualification/mastery.
accessibility.focus_order: Logical document/task order; after source inspection or feedback focus returns to the task heading/control.
